answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust mechanism for Sybil resistance in agent economies, requiring participants to lock collateral to validate transactions. This stake acts as a bridge between digital identity and real-world capital, effectively ensuring that an attacker must deplete their own financial wharf to exert influence. While a malicious agent might craft a sybil identity with the grace of a sonnet, they cannot bypass the prohibitive capital cost of acquiring enough stake to subvert the consensus protocol.
